notes.title: Bugfixes and balancing
notes.notes: [h2]🐞 [b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It was no longer possible to build walls[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy units sometimes appeared red at the start of a battle and stayed that way[/p][/*][*][p]Clay pits could no longer snap together[/p][/*][*][p]Fire mage projectiles simply disappeared when placed on walls[/p][/*][*][p]If the player was still in the building menu when a battle started, the buttons remained visible[/p][/*][*][p]When sending a merchant to a resource, the button didn’t disappear. Pressing it again caused an error[/p][/*][*][p]When trying to move a building, the rest of the UI remained active[/p][/*][*][p]If a building was completed while the player was under attack, it appeared in the overworld after the next load instead of in the village[/p][/*][/list][h2]⚖️ [b]Balancing:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]AI now “thinks” significantly slower, giving the player more time overall[/p][/*][*][p]Defense bonus of walls and towers has been increased[/p][/*][*][p]The number of peasants spawned per skill point increased from 1 to 3[/p][/*][*][p]Merchant movement speed has been doubled[/p][/*][*][p]Peasants are now slightly more durable[/p][/*][*][p]Fire mages now deal less damage to buildings[/p][/*][*][p]AIs can now only send armies every few minutes — a random interval between 3 and 6 minutes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small improvements and bugfixes
notes.notes: [h2]🛠️ [b]Improvements:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It's now easier to select units placed on walls[/p][/*][*][p]Placing units on walls has been slightly improved[/p][/*][*][p]The castle icon will now wiggle while the player is under attack[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🐞 [b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]After units took damage, not all colors were correctly reset[/p][/*][*][p]When a wall or tower was destroyed during combat and a unit was standing on it, the unit now dies instead of floating[/p][/*][*][p]Fire mages were unable to recognize towers as buildings[/p][/*][*][p]When moving a wall with a unit on top, the unit would remain floating in the air[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]⚖️ [b]Balancing:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]AI opponents can now only have one attack army at a time to prevent overwhelming the player in the endgame[/p][/*][*][p]AIs now use fewer archers during attacks[/p][/*][*][p]All melee units are now more durable[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Info buttons and bug fixes
notes.notes: [h2]🛠️ [b]Improvements:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Tooltips are now available for all buildings and all units.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371533/7eb3d26a98dd602f85cb09f68f65de1223688054.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The easiest difficulty level has been made slightly easier.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It was possible to speed up game time by repeatedly pressing Pause and Play.[/p][/*][*][p]Villagers no longer drop into negative numbers when popularity is low.[/p][/*][*][p]It was not possible to place multiple clay pits next to each other, even though it appeared to be allowed.[/p][/*][*][p]If food rations were set to -5 and the game was reloaded, they were reset to 0.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes and balancing
notes.notes: [h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]In castle view, if no path was available, units could no longer be placed during an attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Units were made narrower to better fit through tight corridors.[/p][/*][*][p]Workers are now teleported back to the storage after a while if they have no path.[/p][/*][*][p]If a trade was canceled, the button wasn’t hidden, and pressing it again caused an error.[/p][/*][*][p]If a merchant returned to the castle after a canceled trade, they were counted twice for the player.[/p][/*][*][p]It was possible to need a negative amount of merchants which then got added to the players merchants.[/p][/*][*][p]If the skill UI was still open while being attacked, it remained open and allowed unintended actions 🙂[/p][/*][*][p]Armies and merchants could no longer find the player's city after loading the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowering the sound slider to halfway made the audio so quiet it was barely audible (this may affect existing settings).[/p][/*][*][p]Workers should no longer stand in front of the storage and do their working animation after loading[/p][/*][*][p]After pausing and unpausing the game was running faster in the background[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ Balancing Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Merchants now costs 35 gold instead of 100.[/p][/*][*][p]The market now costs 100 gold instead of 200.[/p][/*][*][p]Stables now require 10 less wood and stone.[/p][/*][*][p]Walls and towers now provide significantly more defense bonus to units stationed on them.[/p][/*][*][p]Bakers now require more wheat but produce more bread per work cycle.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other changes:[/h3][list][*][p]The quarríes will now be placed further appart from each other by default[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and small improvements
notes.notes: [h3]🔧 Adjustments:[/h3][list][*][p]The cost of the church has been reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Buttons for recruiting units and accessing the skill tree are now also available in the castle view[/p][/*][*][p]Mages now deal less damage to buildings[/p][/*][*][p]A sound effect now plays when research is completed[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes in the Last Two Versions:[/h3][list][*][p]Win and Lose screen buttons were not working[/p][/*][*][p]A crash occurred when an army had a negative player index[/p][/*][*][p]There was a ghost town with a negative player index[/p][/*][*][p]Workers sometimes got so heavily congested at the storage area that they couldn’t move away[/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally, skill configurations failed to load correctly, resetting everything back to zero[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to Kekskiller for reporting these issues :)[/p]

notes.title: The new demo will release very soon!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]At the beginning of the year, I decided to completely reprogram the game to optimize the code and rework the core gameplay.[/p][p]Over time, I grew dissatisfied with the old system, so I changed it entirely.[/p][p]The game is now a fast-paced real-time strategy experience with the same mechanics as before, but significantly more performant and stable.[/p][p]This makes future updates easier and faster to develop.[/p][p]I’ve also tried to make the code as mod-friendly as possible, so that mods can be easily supported later on.[/p][p]I’m not ready to announce an exact release date yet, as I’m still in the testing phase — but if you’d like to help out by hunting bugs, feel free to reach out and join in![/p][p]I’m excited to release the demo soon![/p][p]Best regards, Maikel – GamingPugsStudios[/p]
